document.title: Hello World
document.description: Welcome to my new portfolio blog!
document.author: Ayush Kumar Jha

body.raw:
# Hello World

Welcome to my new portfolio. This blog is built with **Next.js 16**, **Tailwind 4**, and **Contentlayer**.

```typescript
const hello = "world";
console.log(hello);
```

I'll be sharing insights on ML, AI, and startup engineering here.
